The palette consists of crisp whites, warm skin tones, and pops of coral against neutral backgrounds. The camera is static, focusing on the detailed texture of her black overcoat and the sharp lines of her bobbed hair. [Shot 2] At 00:01.500, the shot cuts to an energetic handheld follow shot tracking <Subject 2> as she moves through a crowded Manhattan crosswalk. She walks confidently amidst a flow of pedestrians in business attire. The camera moves with a large amplitude shake and fast speed, creating a sense of urban urgency. Amidst the movement, a quick close-up insert reveals <Subject 3> being held by a hand, the matte coral surface catching the soft daylight. The background features the blurred architecture of New York City and white-striped crosswalk markings under a clear sky.
